draft.title: Uniting Japan
card: From the 1460s Japan was torn by civil war between rival daimyo, the regional lords. Each fought for land and power, and the shogun could not control them. This period is called the Warring States period.
Three leaders brought the war to an end, one after another. Oda Nobunaga defeated many rival daimyo and began the work of uniting Japan.
Toyotomi Hideyoshi, who served under Nobunaga, carried on after Nobunaga's death in 1582. He won control of most of the country.
Tokugawa Ieyasu won a great battle at Sekigahara in 1600. In 1603 he became shogun, and the Tokugawa shogunate began.
draft.remember: Nobunaga, then Hideyoshi, then Ieyasu ended the civil war, and the Tokugawa shogunate began in 1603.

a.q: What was the main result of the work of Nobunaga, Hideyoshi and Ieyasu?
opts: They ended the civil war and united Japan
They made the emperor the ruler of Japan again
They drove foreign traders out of every port
They ended the power of the daimyo for good
a.why: The three leaders defeated rival daimyo one after another, and so ended the long civil war. The emperor did not take power back: Ieyasu became shogun in 1603.
a.clue: Think about what the civil war was and how it ended.

opts: Ieyasu became shogun and the Tokugawa shogunate began
Nobunaga defeated many rival daimyo
Nobunaga died and Hideyoshi carried on his work
Hideyoshi won control of most of Japan
b.why: Ieyasu became shogun in 1603, after Nobunaga's death in 1582 and Hideyoshi's rise. The other events came earlier in the order of the three leaders.
b.clue: Which leader came third, and when did his shogunate begin?

a.best: They ended the civil war and united Japan

b.best: Ieyasu became shogun and the Tokugawa shogunate began

They gave power back to the emperor

They started the war between rival daimyo
a.why: The three leaders defeated rival daimyo one after another, and so ended the long civil war and united Japan. The emperor did not take power back: Ieyasu became shogun in 1603. The war had already begun in the 1460s, before these leaders.
a.clue: Think about what the civil war was and how it ended.

opts: Ieyasu became the new shogun of Japan
